Summary: The BLS Employment Situation report for April 2026 is scheduled for release on Friday, May 8, 2026, at 8:30 AM Eastern Time, according to the BLS Schedule of Selected Releases 2026. This release deviates from the usual first Friday of the month pattern due to the BLS's own calendar revision following the autumn 2025 shutdown. The default release time remains 8:30 AM ET.
